geo.title: Get started
geo.body:
Prove a shape is a square using distances and slopes.

Goal: I can prove a quadrilateral is a rhombus, rectangle, or square on the coordinate plane.

slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
To prove a quadrilateral is a:

Rhombus: show all four sides are equal (distance formula). Rectangle: show it is a parallelogram with one right angle (perpendicular slopes) or with equal diagonals. Square: show it is both.

Example: (0, 0), (3, 1), (2, 4), (−1, 3). Each side has length √10. Slopes 1/3 and −3 multiply to −1, so the sides are perpendicular. It is a square.
